name: XLA_SUBLEDGERS
description: Fusion Subledger Application Table. FND_APPLICATION_VL is replaced by this table.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Functional area within a software suite of products. For example, Financials, or Payroll.

columns.name: IMPLEMENTATION_MODE_CODE
columns.description: Method via which metadata and transaction data will be created and maintained. Potential values are ORIGINAL and SIMPLIFIED.

columns.name: PSFT_GL_FLAG
columns.description: PSFT_GL_FLAG

columns.name: JE_SOURCE_NAME
columns.description: Code used to indicate the origin of journal entries such as payables, receivables, or manual.

columns.name: VALUATION_METHOD_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether a valuation of an underlying accounting event that can be valued with a different monetary value and accounted differently.

columns.name: SECURITY_FUNCTION_NAME
columns.description: Name of the security function associated with the subledger application.

columns.name: APPLICATION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the application is seeded or not.

columns.name: ALC_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the application supports alternate currency feature.

columns.name: CONTROL_ACCOUNT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicated the third party control account type the application supported

columns.name: DRILLDOWN_PROCEDURE_NAME
columns.description: Subledger drill down procedure name.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REMOTE_URL
columns.description: Remote web application link.

columns.name: ROW_LOCKING_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if Create Accounting will lock individual events when processing them or if it will lock the entire application and ledger. A value of null or Y indicates it will lock individual events. A value of N indicates it will lock the entire application and ledger.

columns.name: APPLICATION_SHORT_NAME
columns.description: Abbreviated name of a functional area within a software suite of products. For example, Financials or Payroll.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_ENABLED
columns.description: Flag to indicate if accounting is enabled.

columns.name: REMOTE_PILLAR_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the application is set up as a cross pillar application.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ALLOW_REVERSALS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether transaction reversal is enabled for the subledger.

columns.name: AUTO_DELETE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether automatic deletion of invalid transactions is allowed for Accounting Hub Cloud subledgers.

columns.name: MPA_ROW_LOCKING_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if Multiperiod Accounting will lock individual multiperiod entries when processing them or if it will lock the entire application and ledger. A value of Y indicates it will lock individual multiperiod entries. A value of null or N indicates it will lock the entire application and ledger.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: DEFAULT_CALC_SR_BALANCE_FLAG
columns.description: Default value for the maintain supporting reference option for new ledger.
